no_adcom_quote.quote: Neither application was taken before an FDA Advisory Committee because Dysport (abobotulinumtoxinA) is not the first in its class, the clinical study designs were acceptable, no significant safety or efficacy issues

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for BLA 125274 (Dysport/abobotulinumtoxinA). The Office Director Memo (Summary Review, 125274Orig1s001, April 29, 2009) states neither the cervical dystonia nor glabellar lines application was taken before an Advisory Committee because the product is not first in its class, study designs were acceptable, and no significant safety, efficacy, or public-health questions were raised. The companion Summary Review likewise records 'None' under its Advisory Committee Meeting section. Because no committee met, there are no concern-to-change linkages.
